about: The 28-day Avapro supply on 12 February covers the latest serum potassium result of 5.9 mmol/L on 10 March.
Possible finding: ramipril (an ACE inhibitor) is supplied and the record holds no line about a serum potassium result.
Candesartan (an ARB) is supplied, but the potassium results are 4.4 and 4.7 mmol/L, both below 5.5, so it must not flag.
